method: Inspected the 7-column by 2-row contact sheet in ascending ID order, plus individual 256px C_baby_03 and C_baby_12 to examine the closest smiling three-quarter pair. No art modifications.
overall: PASS for apparent 0-2 age, bonnet and swaddling. No obvious exact clone identified. Distinguishability is adequate with qualifications about similar poses and infant facial proportions.

similarity_notes: 03 and 12 share a strong three-quarter smiling infant template; individual inspection confirms different mouth opening, eyes and hairline, so not an obvious exact clone.
07 and 13 are both frontal smiling brown-haired infants; face width, cheek fullness and smile shape distinguish them.
01, 05 and 14 share a serious left-looking pose; hair color and eye/mouth details distinguish them, but these cues may be less legible at 96px.
limitations: Age ranges are subjective apparent-age estimates, not verified ages.
